title: Never Forgotten
story:
An elderly woman carefully tended a small garden behind her house.

Every morning she watered the plants, removed the weeds, and watched each flower bloom.

One day, her grandson asked,

“Grandma, why do you spend so much time caring for these little plants?”

She smiled and gently replied,

“Because every one of them matters to me.

If I ignored them, they would wither.

I planted them, so I won't abandon them.”

The boy looked across the colorful garden and realized that every flower received the same loving care.

God's love is even greater.

He has chosen His people and calls them His own.

Because of His great name and unfailing love, He never abandons those who belong to Him.

Even when we stumble or feel forgotten, God remains faithful.

His promises never fail, and His love never lets us go.
life_lesson: God never abandons those who belong to Him. His faithfulness is greater than our failures.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for choosing me and making me Your own.

Thank You that You never leave or forsake Your children.

When I feel weak or forgotten, remind me of Your unfailing love.

Help me to trust Your faithfulness every day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you ever felt forgotten or alone?

How does God's promise to never forsake His people strengthen your heart today?

How can you respond to His faithful love with greater trust and obedience?
verse: For the Lord will not reject His people, because of His great name, because it has pleased the Lord to make you His own.
